risks.risk: The interior may have mold, odor, or contamination from previous use, not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of the interior with the light on, showing all corners and surfaces, especially the drain area.
risks.if_unproven: priced as contaminated or requiring deep cleaning

risks.risk: The brand 'Logik' may be incorrect or misleading; the actual brand is not visible in any photo.

A video showing the freezer running with the door closed and the interior temperature after 24 hours.
